glosses: to throw away, to discard, to dispose of, to chuck out
to have a miscarriage, to miscarry

examples.text: Так и быть: выкину в окно чернильницу и бумагу, изломаю все станки, уничтожу перья и типографии;

glosses: выдвигать на видное место, поднимать, выставлять

examples.text: Задымились крестьянские избы, погнулись по ветру сизые столбы дыма, точно вереница речных судов выкинула свои флаги;
Подчёркнутые строки в французской статье можно, кажется, выкинуть.
М. боится, что её скоро за какой-нибудь пустяк выкинут с позором со службы, и хочет, чтобы её заявлению был дан ход.
Тотчас узнал я по лицу Гаврилу Семёновича и выкинул сто рублей для рабочих, чтоб усерднее и скорее стали откачивать: но уже было поздно, и он скончался.

glosses: разг., перен., неодобр. проделать, учинить, совершить что-либо

examples.text: Я ему дал спектакль благородный, на который он прямо из деревни в метель в крестьянских санях прискакал, одет в мундир, но и тут особенную выкинул странность
Скоро по приезде нашем в Москву жена нечаянно выкинула в самой ранней поре беременности, но это не имело никакого следствия кроме того, что она тотчас потом снова понесла.
Они гадают о том, выкинут завтра в магазине маринованные помидоры в банках или всё это враки.

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see throw, out.
To discard; to dispense with something; to throw away.

examples.text: Just throw that pen out if it doesn't write anymore.
They decided to throw out the idea because it would have been too expensive.
I picked up Eminem and I liked it. He pretty much threw out today's standardized thug/club/dance and stack paper philosophy that a jabillion other rappers have already adapted.

The episode also opens with an inspired bit of business for Homer, who blithely refuses to acquiesce to an elderly neighbor’s utterly reasonable request that he help make the process of selling her house easier by wearing pants when he gallivants about in front of windows, throw out his impressive collection of rotting Jack-O-Lanterns from previous Halloweens and take out his garbage, as it’s attracting wildlife (cue moose and Northern Exposure theme song).

glosses: To dismiss or expel someone from any longer performing duty or attending somewhere.

examples.text: The board threw the man out, because he wouldn't cooperate and agree with their plans to remodernize the facility.
The ushers threw the woman out of the auditorium, because she kept shouting out insults to the guest of honor when he made his speech.

glosses: To offer an idea for consideration.

examples.text: Let me throw this out there – how about if we make the igloo out of butter? Would that work?
I throw out a challenge to the gay community to dare to walk into this dark corner and offer the light of brotherly love to help these people find themselves.

glosses: To produce in a haphazard fashion.

examples.text: This program keeps throwing out errors.

glosses: To utter carelessly (a remark, suggestion, proposal, etc.).

examples.text: He threw out a couple of half-baked ideas.

Using the countless tons of rock from the cliff-face, supplemented by much more from inland, they threw out a huge breakwater, 2,000 ft. long and 80 ft. high, roughly at right angles to the quay, so forming an almost completely sheltered corner. Fifty years later, this massive mole is still standing up to the worst that the Irish Sea can do.

glosses: To put into a state of confusion.
To cause or experience debilitating muscle or joint pain in (a body part).

examples.text: ...while he was putting on his coat, after having completed his work, in preparing to leave for home, he threw out his shoulder.
But why wasn't Mom there? Sick? No. Threw out her back carrying boxes of blood at a blood drive.

glosses: To discard (trash, garbage, or the like), to toss out, to put in the trash.

examples.text: He wanted to throw away the cup, but he couldn't find a trash can.
Don't throw the newspaper away, it goes in the recycle bin!
Voting for a third-party candidate sometimes feels like throwing your vote away.
The team threw away its chance at the semifinals.
Mama, life has just begun. / But now I've gone and thrown it all away.
Chelsea threw away two points when substitute Salomon Kalou gifted Valencia a penalty five minutes from time with a needless handball.

glosses: To intentionally throw an incomplete pass.
To give lightly, in an offhand manner.

examples.text: As Gilly plays sitcom wife, reading aloud from a book while Sam tries to read his own across the table, she throws away a line about someone named Maynard once having annulled the marriage of someone named Prince Raggar and remarrying him in the same ceremony in Dorne.
вы́кинуть ве́щи из ваго́на
examples.translation: 把东西从车厢里扔出去

glosses: 摒棄，拋棄，丟棄；刪去，刪除

examples.text: вы́кинуть ли́шние слова́ из статьи́
examples.translation: 从文章中删去多余的词句

glosses: 伸出（手、腳）；舉起；掛出（旗子、信號等）

examples.text: вы́кинуть вперёд ру́ки
Враг вы́кинул бе́лый флаг.
вы́кинуть ло́зунг

glosses: 生長出，抽出（嫩芽、苗、穗等）

examples.text: вы́кинуть коло́сья
вы́кинуть това́р на ры́нок
examples.translation: 把商品投放到市场上去

glosses: 做出，搞出，弄出；使（性子），發（脾氣）

examples.text: вы́кинуть трю́ки
вы́кинуть коле́но
